card.line: Galeed is the name of a mound of stones where Jacob and Laban made a promise of peace, with God as their witness.

moments.title: A mound of witness
moments.text: Jacob and his relatives gathered stones and made a mound, and they ate there. Laban called it Jegar-sahadutha, and Jacob called it Galeed, which means heap of witness.

moments.title: A promise of peace
moments.text: Laban said the mound and the pillar were witnesses that neither man would pass them to harm the other. He asked the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor to judge between them, and Jacob swore by the Fear of his father Isaac.

moments.title: Sacrifice and a meal
moments.text: Jacob offered a sacrifice on the mountain and invited his relatives to eat. They spent the night there.
